note: Golden + edge vectors for the PayPal dispute deadline and evidence producer (PAYPAL-DISPUTE-DEADLINE-NODE-1). Coverage: all four disputes.js reasons (including missing-evidence shapes), past-due inquiry, seller_response_due_date passthrough, the three stage-scoping branches (chargeback+card CE3.0-shaped bundle; inquiry/claim/paypal-funded paypal_process_evidence; unknown funding withheld), NOT STATED deadline postures for chargeback and both appeal stages, and six named refusals. Every deadline number is PayPal-stated via research/clause-snapshots/paypal-disputes-2026-10/SNAPSHOT.md; NOT STATED windows are null with a reason. golden_hash pending - run `node golden-parity.test.mjs --update` to pin it.

vectors.name: chargeback_card_unauthorised_ce30_bundle
vectors.description: Network dispute golden: CHARGEBACK on a card-funded transaction with UNAUTHORISED and full fulfillment evidence. The CE3.0-shaped bundle is emitted with art-297 field names verbatim: delivery_proof carries a real SHA-256 digest over the JCS-canonical fulfillment evidence and bound_transaction_ref bound to the synthetic transaction ref; ap2_mandate, tap_signature, agentic_token and prior_transactions are null (no PayPal counterpart); reason_code is null (mapping NOT STATED). seller_response_due_date passthrough supplies the only stated deadline.

seller_response.basis: seller_response_due_date passthrough: "The date and time by when the merchant must respond to the dispute, in Internet date and time format." (S5); consequence "If the merchant does not respond by this date and time, the dispute is closed in the customer's favor." (S5)

required_evidence.why: prove the goods reached the cardholder (or their address) with carrier + tracking

bundle_decision.reason: Chargeback on a card-funded transaction: the network dispute case. CE3.0-shaped bundle emitted for consumption by art-297 (mcp:lint_compelling_evidence_ce30_agentic).

ce30_shaped_bundle.label: CE3.0-shaped bundle for consumption by art-297 (mcp:lint_compelling_evidence_ce30_agentic); Visa CE3.0 is a card-network program, not a PayPal one
ce30_shaped_bundle.null_fields_note: ap2_mandate, tap_signature, agentic_token: no PayPal counterpart (PayPal produces no AP2 mandate, TAP signature or agentic token for a dispute). reason_code: PayPal-to-network reason-code mapping NOT STATED in the PayPal snapshot. prior_transactions: PayPal Disputes API states no prior-transaction linkage data.

cited_clauses.quote: The date and time by when the merchant must respond to the dispute, in Internet date and time format.

vectors.name: refused_unknown_reason
vectors.description: A real schema v1.12 enum value beyond the four disputes.js reasons (DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION, SNAPSHOT.md section 3) is refused with REFUSED_UNKNOWN_DISPUTE_REASON, mirroring the lib UnknownDisputeReasonError: never guess evidence for an unmapped reason.

output_payload.detail: dispute_reason must be one of MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_RECEIVED, MERCHANDISE_OR_SERVICE_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED, UNAUTHORISED, CREDIT_NOT_PROCESSED; received "DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION". Refusing to guess evidence for an unmapped reason.

vectors.name: refused_rollover_timestamp
vectors.description: Rollover date 2026-02-30 is rejected: REFUSED_BAD_DISPUTE_CREATE_TIME. Only strict ISO-8601 UTC timestamps are accepted.

output_payload.detail: dispute_create_time must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(.SSS)Z; received "2026-02-30T12:00:00Z"

vectors.name: refused_missing_as_of
vectors.description: as_of is required (the kernel never reads a wall clock): its absence is REFUSED_BAD_AS_OF.

output_payload.detail: as_of must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(.SSS)Z; the kernel never reads a wall clock; received null

vectors.name: refused_bad_stage
vectors.description: lifecycle_stage outside the snapshot enum (dispute_life_cycle_stage, schema v1.12) is REFUSED_UNKNOWN_LIFECYCLE_STAGE.

output_payload.detail: lifecycle_stage must be one of INQUIRY, CHARGEBACK, PRE_ARBITRATION, ARBITRATION; received "RETRIEVAL"

vectors.name: refused_bad_funding
vectors.description: funding_source outside the desk-amendment enum is REFUSED_UNKNOWN_FUNDING_SOURCE.

output_payload.detail: funding_source must be one of card, paypal_balance_or_bank, unknown; received "wire"

vectors.name: refused_bad_due_date_passthrough
vectors.description: A malformed seller_response_due_date passthrough (local offset instead of Z) is REFUSED_BAD_SELLER_RESPONSE_DUE_DATE; a bad passthrough is refused rather than silently dropped.

output_payload.detail: seller_response_due_date, when supplied, must be an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(.SSS)Z; received "2026-10-11T12:00:00+02:00"
